body: I was honored to be invited to speak to the Disciples of Christ General Assembly in Nashville the last two days. A great spirit … wonderful people. It’s encouraging to see many innovative young leaders finding a good home in this denomination … a group that produces a disproportionately high number of thoughtful scholars, writers, pastors, church planters, and activists.
